description: Adds a Preview button to the editor footer for HTML, XHTML, and SVG files. Renders the code view's content in an isolated preview that updates live as the file changes — in the editor or on disk. The page may navigate within the project tree (sibling and subdirectory pages); leaving the tree stops the preview with a warning.
author: SoftwareRenderer

properties.title: Enable scripts (reduces isolation)
properties.description: By default the preview runs with scripts disabled and strict egress — only local, inline, and data: assets load, and nothing can be sent out. Enable to run the page's JavaScript: network egress stays blocked (no fetch, no remote loads) and the preview stops with a warning if the page tries to navigate away. Applies when the editor is next opened.

properties.title: Allow network access (with scripts only)
properties.description: Lets the page fetch data and load remote resources — the preview behaves like a normal browser for loading content. Only applies with 'Enable scripts' on; use only for your own pages.
